messages:
Nora: quick UX report from usability session — on narrow phones the left-edge rail swipe is intercepting horizontal table pans. Users trying to reveal row actions get the rail instead. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/edge-swipe-conflict.png :grimacing:
Ibrahim: which devices/viewport? repro steps?
Nora: iPhone SE + Pixel 4a, viewport ~360px, table with long IDs that scroll horizontally. Swipe from ~20-40px from left opens rail.
Ken: analytics picked up a small increase in "open row" abandonments for mobile this week. could be linked.
Rae: accessibility: when the rail steals focus mid-pan TalkBack/VoiceOver interrupts reading. Also the rail handle's visible area is <44px in places.
Ibrahim: short fix options: (A) reduce edge gesture zone to 8-12px under 380px, (B) opt-out horizontal-scrolling containers via `.no-rail-swipe`, (C) add `touch-action: pan-y` to table containers. I can prototype (A)+(C) fast.
Jules: another tiny win — change mobile action label from "Details" -> "Open panel" so its clearer the row action overlays the screen. Ship copy independently if needed.
Nora: agree on copy and gesture scoping. Also add a subtle peek handle (thin stripe) visible at the edge so users discover the rail but it's less intrusive.
Rae: ensure handle has aria-label="Open rail" and a 44x44 interactive hit area. When we opt-out by element, make sure keyboard users still have a focusable control to open the rail (offscreen button in header).
Ibrahim: CSS quick test I'll try:
```css
@media (max-width: 380px){
  .console-table{ touch-action: pan-y; }
  .gesture-edge{ width: 10px; }
  .peek-handle{ width:4px; }
}
```
Ibrahim: opening WIP PR with these changes and the copy tweak: https://git.redwood/PR/4722 (WIP) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
gesture-bot: automation note  added mobile-gesture-e2e to staging (build 2026.05.10-07).
Ibrahim: will post staging results here after deploy. Nora/Ken/Rae can we do a 10m check on staging after build?
Nora: yes please. Posting a short design note with two variants and the preferred copy. :+1:
